blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
The verb to have shows possession or responsibility. I have a contract. She has a meeting. We have three invoices.

In English, we say have for I, you, we and they. We say has for he, she and it. So: I have a receipt, but she has a receipt. The company has 13 offices. They have a new client in India.

At work, we use have and has every day. I have three invoices today. Ethan has a meeting at 3. We have a payment due Friday. You have my number. And 💛 we have time to learn.

items.q: Which word do we use with "she"?
items.why: Com he, she e it usamos "has": she has a meeting.

items.q: Complete: "I ___ three invoices today."
items.why: Com "I" usamos "have": I have three invoices.

items.q: How many offices does the company have?
items.why: "The company has 13 offices."

items.q: The text suggests that "have" and "has"…
options: are used at work every day
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz "At work, we use have and has every day."

items.q: Which sentence is correct?
items.why: Inferência da regra: Ethan (he) usa "has" — Ethan has a meeting.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Ethan falando com o novo trader sobre a pasta de faturas. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team. Let's look at the invoice folder together. It is not difficult, I promise.

So, we have three invoices this week. I have the first one here. It is from India, and the total is high. We have a payment due on Friday, so this one is important.

The second invoice is from Brazil. She has the receipt on email — I will ask her to send it to you. The deadline is next Monday.

The third one is small. The company has a receipt for it already, so we are okay. No payment now.

You have my number, right? Good. If a client has a question about a total or a deadline, call me. And remember: I have a meeting at three, so we finish before that. We have time. Any questions?
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How many invoices do they have this week?
items.why: "we have three invoices this week."

items.q: When is the payment due?
items.why: "We have a payment due on Friday."

items.q: Who has the receipt on email?
items.why: "She has the receipt on email."

items.q: The third invoice is not a problem now. Why?
options: The company already has a receipt for it
items.why: Inferência: "The company has a receipt for it already, so we are okay. No payment now."

items.q: Why does Ethan want to finish before three o'clock?
options: He has a meeting at three
items.why: Inferência: "I have a meeting at three, so we finish before that."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please send the invoice to the client today." An invoice is…
items.why: Invoice = fatura, o documento que pede o pagamento.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "After I pay, I keep the ___ as proof."
items.why: Receipt = recibo, a prova de que você pagou.

items.q: "We have a payment due Friday." Payment means…
items.why: Payment = pagamento.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ is Monday, so we must pay before that day."
items.why: Deadline = prazo final, o último dia para fazer algo.

items.q: "The total has increased this month." Total means…
items.why: Total = total, o valor completo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The invoice is due Friday." This means the payment…
items.why: Due Friday = o prazo é sexta; precisa ser pago até sexta.

items.q: "Can you send over the receipt?" To send over means to…
items.why: Send over = enviar (para a pessoa).

items.q: "I need to pay off this invoice today." To pay off means to…
items.why: Pay off = quitar, pagar por completo.

items.q: "Let's go over the totals together." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, conferir juntos.

items.q: "Please fill out this form for the receipt." To fill out means to…
items.why: Fill out = preencher com as informações.
